<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="ko" data-theme="dark" data-accent="orange">

<head>

  <meta charset="UTF-8" />

  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />

  <meta name="theme-color" content="#13161B" id="meta-theme-color" />

  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />

  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />

  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="chulta4" />

  <title>chulta4 — 출타 · 일정 공유 캘린더</title>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net" crossorigin />

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable-dynamic-subset.min.css" />

  <style>

    :root {

      --bg: #13161B;

      --surface: #1A1E25;

      --surface-2: #222731;

      --surface-hover: #272D38;

      --border: #2B313C;

      --border-subtle: #20252E;

      --text: #EFF2F6;

      --text-2: #9AA4B2;

      --text-3: #667080;

      --sat: #6B9BD2;

      --sun: #D97A7A;

      --accent: #FF6B00;

      --accent-soft: rgba(255, 107, 0, 0.14);

      --accent-border: rgba(255, 107, 0, 0.42);

      --accent-fg: #FFFFFF;

      --danger: #EF4444;

      --success: #22C55E;

      --sheet-bg: #181C22;

      --backdrop: rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.68);

      --shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);

      --radius: 12px;

      --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);

      --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);

    }

    html[data-theme="light"] {

      --bg: #F6F7F9;

      --surface: #FFFFFF;

      --surface-2: #F0F2F5;

      --surface-hover: #E7EAEE;

      --border: #E2E6EC;

      --border-subtle: #ECEFF3;

      --text: #111827;

      --text-2: #525E6F;

      --text-3: #8A94A3;

      --sat: #3B76BA;

      --sun: #C85A5A;

      --sheet-bg: #FFFFFF;

      --backdrop: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.42);

      --shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);

    }

    html[data-accent="orange"] { --accent: #FF6B00; --accent-soft: rgba(255,107,0,0.14); --accent-border: rgba(255,107,0,0.42); --accent-fg: #FFFFFF; }

    html[data-accent="amber"]  { --accent: #F59E0B; --accent-soft: rgba(245,158,11,0.15); --accent-border: rgba(245,158,11,0.44); --accent-fg: #111827; }

    html[data-accent="coral"]  { --accent: #F43F5E; --accent-soft: rgba(244,63,94,0.14); --accent-border: rgba(244,63,94,0.42); --accent-fg: #FFFFFF; }

    html[data-accent="mono"]   { --accent: #94A3B8; --accent-soft: rgba(148,163,184,0.16); --accent-border: rgba(148,163,184,0.45); --accent-fg: #0F172A; }

    html[data-theme="light"][data-accent="mono"] { --accent: #334155; --accent-soft: rgba(51,65,85,0.10); --accent-border: rgba(51,65,85,0.35); --accent-fg: #FFFFFF; }

    * {

      box-sizing: border-box;

      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;

    }

    html, body {

      margin: 0;

      padding: 0;

      background: var(--bg);

      color: var(--text);

      font-family: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;

      font-size: 14px;

      line-height: 1.45;

      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;

      overscroll-behavior-y: none;

    }

    .tabular { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    .app-shell {

      max-width: 560px;

      min-height: 100dvh;

      margin: 0 auto;

      background: var(--bg);

      border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      padding-bottom: calc(80px + var(--safe-bottom));

    }

    @media (max-width: 560px) {

      .app-shell { border-left: none; border-right: none; }

    }

    /* Sticky Top Header */

    .top-header {

      position: sticky;

      top: 0;

      z-index: 40;

      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent);

      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);

      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

      padding-top: var(--safe-top);

    }

    .header-row {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      padding: 11px 16px 8px;

      gap: 8px;

    }

    .brand {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 8px;

      min-width: 0;

    }

    .brand-title {

      font-size: 16px;

      font-weight: 800;

      letter-spacing: -0.02em;

      color: var(--text);

    }

    .brand-dot {

      color: var(--accent);

    }

    .sync-pill {

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 5px;

      font-size: 11px;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text-2);

      background: var(--surface);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      padding: 2px 8px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      max-width: 130px;

      overflow: hidden;

      text-overflow: ellipsis;

      white-space: nowrap;

    }

    .sync-dot {

      width: 6px;

      height: 6px;

      border-radius: 50%;

      background: var(--text-3);

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    .sync-dot.live { background: #22C55E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.22); }

    .sync-dot.err  { background: #EF4444; }

    .sync-dot.wait { background: #F59E0B; }

    .header-actions {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

    }

    .btn-ghost {

      appearance: none;

      background: var(--surface);

      color: var(--text-2);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: 8px;

      height: 32px;

      padding: 0 10px;

      font-size: 12px;

      font-weight: 600;

      cursor: pointer;

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      gap: 5px;

      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;

    }

    .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }

    .btn-ghost.icon-only { width: 32px; padding: 0; }

    .btn-ghost.active {

      background: var(--accent-soft);

      color: var(--accent);

      border-color: var(--accent-border);

    }

    .btn-accent {

      appearance: none;

      background: var(--accent);

      color: var(--accent-fg);

      border: none;

      border-radius: 8px;

      height: 32px;

      padding: 0 12px;

      font-size: 12px;

      font-weight: 700;

      cursor: pointer;

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      gap: 4px;

      transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.1s;

    }

    .btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

    .btn-accent.lg { height: 42px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 10px; width: 100%; }

    /* X-style Underline Tabs */

    .nav-tabs {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);

      padding: 0 6px;

    }

    .nav-tab {

      position: relative;

      appearance: none;

      background: transparent;

      border: none;

      color: var(--text-2);

      font-size: 13px;

      font-weight: 600;

      padding: 10px 4px;

      cursor: pointer;

      text-align: center;

      transition: color 0.15s;

    }

    .nav-tab.active {

      color: var(--text);

      font-weight: 700;

    }

    .nav-tab.active::after {

      content: "";

      position: absolute;

      left: 20%;

      right: 20%;

      bottom: 0;

      height: 2.5px;

      border-radius: 99px 99px 0 0;

      background: var(--accent);

    }

    .tab-badge {

      display: inline-block;

      margin-left: 3px;

      font-size: 10px;

      font-weight: 700;

      color: var(--accent);

      vertical-align: top;

    }

    /* Mini D-Day Ticker */

    .dday-ticker {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      gap: 10px;

      padding: 9px 16px;

      background: var(--surface);

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

      cursor: pointer;

      transition: background 0.15s;

    }

    .dday-ticker:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }

    .ticker-left {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 8px;

      min-width: 0;

      overflow: hidden;

    }

    .ticker-tag {

      font-size: 11px;

      font-weight: 800;

      padding: 2px 7px;

      border-radius: 6px;

      background: var(--accent-soft);

      color: var(--accent);

      border: 1px solid var(--accent-border);

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    .ticker-text {

      font-size: 12.5px;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text);

      white-space: nowrap;

      overflow: hidden;

      text-overflow: ellipsis;

    }

    .ticker-right {

      font-size: 11.5px;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text-2);

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    /* Filter Bar */

    .filter-section {

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

      background: var(--bg);

      padding: 8px 16px;

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      gap: 7px;

    }

    .chip-row {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

      overflow-x: auto;

      scrollbar-width: none;

      -ms-overflow-style: none;

      padding-bottom: 1px;

    }

    .chip-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .chip {

      appearance: none;

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      background: var(--surface);

      color: var(--text-2);

      font-size: 12px;

      font-weight: 600;

      padding: 5px 10px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      cursor: pointer;

      white-space: nowrap;

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 5px;

      flex-shrink: 0;

      transition: all 0.15s;

    }

    .chip.selected {

      background: var(--accent-soft);

      border-color: var(--accent-border);

      color: var(--text);

    }

    .chip.person-off {

      opacity: 0.42;

      background: transparent;

    }

    .chip-dot {

      width: 8px;

      height: 8px;

      border-radius: 50%;

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    .chip-divider {

      width: 1px;

      height: 16px;

      background: var(--border);

      flex-shrink: 0;

      margin: 0 2px;

    }

    /* Calendar Toolbar */

    .cal-toolbar {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      padding: 12px 16px 8px;

      gap: 8px;

    }

    .month-nav {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

    }

    .month-title {

      font-size: 17px;

      font-weight: 800;

      letter-spacing: -0.02em;

      min-width: 90px;

      text-align: center;

    }

    .seg-control {

      display: inline-flex;

      background: var(--surface);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: 8px;

      padding: 2px;

    }

    .seg-btn {

      appearance: none;

      border: none;

      background: transparent;

      color: var(--text-2);

      font-size: 11.5px;

      font-weight: 600;

      padding: 4px 9px;

      border-radius: 6px;

      cursor: pointer;

      transition: all 0.15s;

    }

    .seg-btn.active {

      background: var(--surface-2);

      color: var(--text);

      font-weight: 700;

    }

    /* Calendar Grid */

    .cal-month-block {

      margin-bottom: 14px;

    }

    .scroll-month-header {

      padding: 12px 16px 6px;

      font-size: 14px;

      font-weight: 800;

      color: var(--text);

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);

    }

    .weekday-row {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

      padding: 4px 0 6px;

    }

    .weekday-cell {

      text-align: center;

      font-size: 11px;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text-3);

    }

    .weekday-cell.sun { color: var(--sun); }

    .weekday-cell.sat { color: var(--sat); }

    .week-row {

      position: relative;

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

      min-height: 82px;

      user-select: none;

      -webkit-user-select: none;

    }

    .week-bg-grid {

      position: absolute;

      inset: 0;

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);

      z-index: 1;

    }

    .day-bg-cell {

      border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

      cursor: pointer;

      position: relative;

      transition: background 0.12s;

    }

    .day-bg-cell:last-child { border-right: none; }

    .day-bg-cell:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-2) 55%, transparent); }

    .day-bg-cell.other-month { opacity: 0.35; }

    .day-bg-cell.selected-day { background: var(--accent-soft); }

    .doodle-thumb {

      position: absolute;

      inset: 22px 2px 2px 2px;

      width: calc(100% - 4px);

      height: calc(100% - 24px);

      object-fit: contain;

      opacity: 0.32;

      pointer-events: none;

    }

    .week-header-grid {

      position: relative;

      z-index: 2;

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);

      pointer-events: none;

    }

    .day-num-wrap {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      padding: 4px 5px 2px;

    }

    .day-num {

      font-size: 11.5px;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text-2);

      width: 21px;

      height: 21px;

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: center;

      border-radius: 999px;

    }

    .day-num.sun { color: var(--sun); }

    .day-num.sat { color: var(--sat); }

    .day-num.other { opacity: 0.35; }

    .day-num.today {

      background: var(--accent);

      color: var(--accent-fg);

      font-weight: 800;

    }

    .day-note-dot {

      width: 5px;

      height: 5px;

      border-radius: 50%;

      background: var(--accent);

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    .week-bars {

      position: relative;

      z-index: 3;

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      gap: 2px;

      padding: 1px 0 5px;

      pointer-events: none;

    }

    .bar-lane {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);

      min-height: 18px;

    }

    .ev-bar {

      pointer-events: auto;

      cursor: pointer;

      height: 18px;

      line-height: 16px;

      font-size: 10.5px;

      font-weight: 700;

      padding: 0 5px;

      margin: 0 1.5px;

      border-radius: 4px;

      overflow: hidden;

      text-overflow: ellipsis;

      white-space: nowrap;

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 3px;

      transition: filter 0.12s;

    }

    .ev-bar:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }

    .ev-bar.cont-left { margin-left: 0; border-top-left-radius: 0; border-bottom-left-radius: 0; }

    .ev-bar.cont-right { margin-right: 0; border-top-right-radius: 0; border-bottom-right-radius: 0; }

    /* Outing vs Part-time & Draft styling */

    .ev-bar.kind-outing {

      color: #FFFFFF;

      border: 1px solid transparent;

    }

    .ev-bar.kind-outing.is-draft {

      background: transparent !important;

      border: 1px dashed var(--ev-color);

      color: var(--text);

      opacity: 0.88;

    }

    .ev-bar.kind-work {

      background: var(--surface-2) !important;

      color: var(--text);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-left: 3px solid var(--ev-color);

      font-weight: 600;

    }

    .ev-bar.kind-work.is-draft {

      border-style: dashed;

      border-left-style: solid;

      opacity: 0.78;

    }

    .more-row {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);

      position: relative;

      z-index: 3;

      pointer-events: none;

      padding-bottom: 3px;

    }

    .more-cell {

      font-size: 10px;

      font-weight: 700;

      color: var(--text-3);

      text-align: center;

    }

    .cal-hint {

      padding: 10px 16px 4px;

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      font-size: 11.5px;

      color: var(--text-3);

      gap: 8px;

      flex-wrap: wrap;

    }

    /* Section Containers (D-Day, Recommend, Activity, Settings) */

    .page-body {

      padding: 14px 16px;

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      gap: 14px;

    }

    .section-label {

      font-size: 11.5px;

      font-weight: 700;

      color: var(--text-3);

      letter-spacing: 0.04em;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      margin-bottom: 8px;

    }

    .card {

      background: var(--surface);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: var(--radius);

      padding: 14px;

    }

    .card-list {

      background: var(--surface);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: var(--radius);

      overflow: hidden;

    }

    .list-item {

      padding: 13px 14px;

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

      display: flex;

      align-items: flex-start;

      justify-content: space-between;

      gap: 12px;

      cursor: pointer;

      transition: background 0.12s;

    }

    .list-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .list-item:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }

    .dday-num {

      font-size: 18px;

      font-weight: 800;

      letter-spacing: -0.02em;

      color: var(--accent);

      white-space: nowrap;

    }

    .dday-num.muted { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 15px; }

    .progress-track {

      height: 5px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: var(--surface-2);

      overflow: hidden;

      margin-top: 8px;

    }

    .progress-fill {

      height: 100%;

      border-radius: 999px;

      background: var(--accent);

    }

    .gap-badge {

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      font-size: 11px;

      font-weight: 600;

      color: var(--text-2);

      background: var(--surface-2);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      padding: 2px 8px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      margin: 4px 0 8px 12px;

    }

    .pill {

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 4px;

      font-size: 11px;

      font-weight: 700;

      padding: 2px 7px;

      border-radius: 6px;

      background: var(--surface-2);

      color: var(--text-2);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

    }

    .pill.accent {

      background: var(--accent-soft);

      color: var(--accent);

      border-color: var(--accent-border);

    }

    .pill.draft {

      border-style: dashed;

      color: var(--text-2);

    }

    .empty-state {

      text-align: center;

      padding: 36px 20px;

      color: var(--text-3);

      background: var(--surface);

      border: 1px dashed var(--border);

      border-radius: var(--radius);

    }

    .empty-title {

      font-size: 14px;

      font-weight: 700;

      color: var(--text-2);

      margin-bottom: 4px;

    }

    .empty-sub {

      font-size: 12.5px;

      color: var(--text-3);

      margin-bottom: 14px;

    }

    /* Form Controls */

    .field {

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      gap: 6px;

      margin-bottom: 12px;

    }

    .field:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .field-label {

      font-size: 12px;

      font-weight: 700;

      color: var(--text-2);

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

    }

    .input, .select, .textarea {

      width: 100%;

      background: var(--bg);

      color: var(--text);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: 9px;

      padding: 10px 12px;

      font-size: 14px;

      font-family: inherit;

      outline: none;

      transition: border-color 0.15s;

    }

    .input:focus, .select:focus, .textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

    .textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 70px; }

    .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }

    .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 6px; }

    .grid-4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 6px; }

    .opt-btn {

      appearance: none;

      background: var(--bg);

      color: var(--text-2);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: 8px;

      padding: 8px 6px;

      font-size: 12px;

      font-weight: 600;

      cursor: pointer;

      text-align: center;

      transition: all 0.14s;

    }

    .opt-btn.active {

      background: var(--accent-soft);

      color: var(--accent);

      border-color: var(--accent-border);

      font-weight: 700;

    }

    .swatch-grid {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);

      gap: 8px;

    }

    .swatch {

      height: 30px;

      border-radius: 8px;

      border: 2px solid transparent;

      cursor: pointer;

      position: relative;

      transition: transform 0.12s;

    }

    .swatch:active { transform: scale(0.92); }

    .swatch.active {

      border-color: var(--text);

      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg) inset;

    }

    /* Bottom Sheet Modal */

    .sheet-backdrop {

      position: fixed;

      inset: 0;

      z-index: 80;

      background: var(--backdrop);

      display: none;

      align-items: flex-end;

      justify-content: center;

      animation: fadeIn 0.16s ease;

    }

    .sheet-backdrop.open { display: flex; }

    .sheet-panel {

      width: 100%;

      max-width: 560px;

      max-height: 88dvh;

      background: var(--sheet-bg);

      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0;

      box-shadow: var(--shadow);

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      overflow: hidden;

      padding-bottom: var(--safe-bottom);

      animation: slideUp 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

    }

    .sheet-handle {

      width: 36px;

      height: 4px;

      border-radius: 99px;

      background: var(--border);

      margin: 9px auto 4px;

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    .sheet-head {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      padding: 8px 16px 12px;

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

      flex-shrink: 0;

    }

    .sheet-title {

      font-size: 16px;

      font-weight: 800;

      letter-spacing: -0.02em;

    }

    .sheet-body {

      padding: 14px 16px 20px;

      overflow-y: auto;

      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;

    }

    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }

    @keyframes slideUp { from { transform: translateY(28px); opacity: 0.7; } to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }

    /* Doodle Canvas */

    .canvas-box {

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      border-radius: 10px;

      overflow: hidden;

      background: var(--bg);

      position: relative;

    }

    .doodle-canvas {

      display: block;

      width: 100%;

      height: 220px;

      touch-action: none;

      cursor: crosshair;

    }

    .canvas-tools {

      display: flex;

      align-items: center;

      justify-content: space-between;

      gap: 6px;

      padding: 8px 10px;

      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);

      background: var(--surface);

      flex-wrap: wrap;

    }

    .pen-dot {

      width: 22px;

      height: 22px;

      border-radius: 50%;

      border: 2px solid transparent;

      cursor: pointer;

    }

    .pen-dot.active { border-color: var(--text); }

    /* RSVP & Comments */

    .rsvp-row {

      display: grid;

      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

      gap: 6px;

      margin: 10px 0;

    }

    .rsvp-btn {

      appearance: none;

      background: var(--bg);

      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      color: var(--text-2);

      border-radius: 9px;

      padding: 8px 6px;

      font-size: 12px;

      font-weight: 700;

      cursor: pointer;

      display: flex;

      flex-direction: column;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 2px;

    }

    .rsvp-btn.active {

      background: var(--accent-soft);

      border-color: var(--accent-border);

      color: var(--accent);

    }

    .rsvp-names {

      font-size: 10.5px;

      font-weight: 500;

      color: var(--text-3);

      max-width: 100%;

      overflow: hidden;

      text-overflow: ellipsis;

      white-space: nowrap;

    }

    .comment-item {

      padding: 9px 0;

      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

    }

    .comment-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    /* FAB */

    .fab {

      position: fixed;

      right: max(16px, calc((100vw - 560px) / 2 + 16px));

      bottom: calc(18px + var(--safe-bottom));

      z-index: 50;

      height: 46px;

      padding: 0 18px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      border: none;

      background: var(--accent);

      color: var(--accent-fg);

      font-size: 13.5px;

      font-weight: 800;

      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);

      cursor: pointer;

      display: inline-flex;

      align-items: center;

      gap: 6px;

      transition: transform 0.14s;

    }

    .fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

    /* Toast */

    .toast {

      position: fixed;

      left: 50%;

      bottom: calc(74px + var(--safe-bottom));

      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);

      z-index: 120;

      background: var(--text);

      color: var(--bg);

      padding: 9px 16px;

      border-radius: 999px;

      font-size: 12.5px;

      font-weight: 700;

      opacity: 0;

      pointer-events: none;

      transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s;

      white-space: nowrap;

      max-width: 90vw;

      overflow: hidden;

      text-overflow: ellipsis;

    }

    .toast.show {

      opacity: 1;

      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);

    }

    .error-banner {

      margin: 10px 16px 0;

      padding: 10px 12px;

      border-radius: 10px;

      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);

      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);

      color: #FCA5A5;

      font-size: 12px;

      display: none;

    }

    html[data-theme="light"] .error-banner { color: #B91C1C; }

    .error-banner.show { display: block; }

  </style>

<body>

  <div class="app-shell">

      </div>

  <script type="module">

    import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js";

      serverTimestamp

    } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js";

    // 혹시 DB 연결 오류가 뜨면 Firebase 콘솔 > 프로젝트 설정 > 내 앱의 firebaseConfig로 교체하세요.

    const firebaseConfig = {

    const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);

    const db = getFirestore(app);

    // =========================================================================

    // Constants & Palette

    // =========================================================================

    const PALETTE = [

    const WORK_SUBTYPES   = ["알바", "대타", "약속", "기타"];

    const DURATION_PRESETS = [

    const CHANGELOGS = [

        version: "v2.0.0",

        items: [

          "링크 하나만으로 지인들과 일정·댓글·RSVP·낙서·변경로그가 실시간 동기화되도록 Firestore 연동",

          "소프트 다크(Dim) 및 라이트 모드, 4종 앱 포인트 컬러, 12색 대표 팔레트 적용",

          "가안(점선)/확정(실선) 전환, 롱프레스 빠른 등록, 원탭 RSVP(만남 가능/조율 필요/불가) 추가",

          "디데이 탭 개수 제한 제거 및 복귀 후 다음 출타까지 간격(텀) 자동 계산",

          "URL 방 코드(?room=...) 전환 및 카톡용 월간 출타 요약 텍스트 복사 지원"

        ]

      },

      {

        version: "v1.2.0",

          "날짜별 고해상도 터치 캔버스 낙서 및 메모 오버레이 기능 추가"

        items: [

          "기존 일정 겹침 분석 기반 최대 만남·특정인 맞춤·한적한 날짜 Top 5 추천 엔진 도입"

        ]

      }

    ];

    // =========================================================================

    // Helpers: Date & Formatting

    // =========================================================================

    const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

    function toYMD(d) {

      return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;

    }

    function parseYMD(s) {

      const [y, m, d] = s.split("-").map(Number);

      return new Date(y, m - 1, d);

    }

    function addDays(ymd, delta) {

      const d = parseYMD(ymd);

      d.setDate(d.getDate() + delta);

      return toYMD(d);

    }

    function diffDays(a, b) {

      const ms = parseYMD(b).getTime() - parseYMD(a).getTime();

      return Math.round(ms / 86400000);

    }

    function todayYMD() {

      return toYMD(new Date());

    }

    const WEEKDAYS = ["일", "월", "화", "수", "목", "금", "토"];

    function fmtShort(ymd) {

      const d = parseYMD(ymd);

      return `${d.getMonth() + 1}/${d.getDate()}(${WEEKDAYS[d.getDay()]})`;

    }

    function fmtRange(s, e) {

      if (s === e) return fmtShort(s);

      return `${fmtShort(s)} ~ ${fmtShort(e)}`;

    }

    function fmtDuration(s, e) {

      const days = diffDays(s, e) + 1;

      if (days <= 1) return "당일";

      return `${days - 1}박 ${days}일`;

    }

    function fmtRelative(isoOrMs) {

      if (!isoOrMs) return "방금";

      const t = typeof isoOrMs === "number" ? isoOrMs : new Date(isoOrMs).getTime();

      const diff = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - t) / 1000));

      if (diff < 60) return "방금 전";

      if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}분 전`;

      if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}시간 전`;

      if (diff < 86400 * 7) return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)}일 전`;

      const d = new Date(t);

      return `${d.getMonth() + 1}/${d.getDate()}`;

    }

    function esc(str) {

      return String(str ?? "")

        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")

        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")

        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")

        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")

        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // App State

    // =========================================================================

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

    const initialRoom = (urlParams.get("room") || "main").trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "") || "main";

    const loadLS = (k, fb) => {

      try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : fb; }

      catch { return fb; }

    };

    const saveLS = (k, v) => {

      try { localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); } catch {}

    };

    const nowDate = new Date();

    const state = {

      roomId: initialRoom,

      syncStatus: "wait", // wait | live | err

      syncError: "",

      tab: "calendar", // calendar | dday | recommend | activity | settings

      activitySub: "logs", // logs | changelog

      theme: loadLS("chulta4_theme", "dark"),

      accent: loadLS("chulta4_accent", "orange"),

      profile: loadLS("chulta4_profile", { name: "", color: "#FF6B00", recentNames: [] }),

      // Calendar view state

      viewMode: loadLS("chulta4_view_mode", "month"), // month | scroll

      calYear: nowDate.getFullYear(),

      calMonth: nowDate.getMonth(), // 0-indexed

      scrollOffsetStart: 0,

      scrollMonthsCount: 4,

      selectedDay: todayYMD(),

      showDoodles: true,

      kindFilter: "all", // all | outing | work

      hiddenPeople: new Set(),

      // D-Day filter state

      ddayHiddenPeople: new Set(),

      showPastOutings: false,

      // Recommend state

      recDays: 4,

      recHorizon: 60,

      recStrategy: "max_meet", // max_meet | target_people | quiet

      recTargets: new Set(),

      // Firestore synced data

      events: [],

      doodles: {}, // { 'YYYY-MM-DD': { image, memo, updatedBy, updatedAt } }

      logs: []

    };

    // Unsubscribe handles for Firestore

    let unsubs = [];

    function applyTheme() {

      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", state.theme);

      document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-accent", state.accent);

      const meta = document.getElementById("meta-theme-color");

      if (meta) meta.setAttribute("content", state.theme === "dark" ? "#13161B" : "#F6F7F9");

      const btn = document.getElementById("btn-theme-toggle");

      if (btn) {

        btn.innerHTML = state.theme === "dark"

          ? `<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.93 19.07l1.41-1.41M17.66 6.34l1.41-1.41"/></svg>`

          : `<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg>`;

      }

    }

    function showToast(msg) {

      const el = document.getElementById("toast");

      el.textContent = msg;

      el.classList.add("show");

      clearTimeout(el._t);

      el._t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("show"), 2300);

    }

    function setSyncStatus(status, errMsg = "") {

      state.syncStatus = status;

      state.syncError = errMsg;

      const dot = document.getElementById("sync-dot");

      const label = document.getElementById("sync-label");

      const banner = document.getElementById("error-banner");

      dot.className = `sync-dot ${status}`;

      if (status === "live") {

        label.textContent = state.roomId === "main" ? "실시간" : `#${state.roomId}`;

        banner.classList.remove("show");

      } else if (status === "wait") {

        label.textContent = "연결 중";

      } else {

        label.textContent = "연결 오류";

        banner.innerHTML = `<strong>DB 연결 확인 필요:</strong> ${esc(errMsg)}<br/>Firebase 규칙 게시 여부 또는 index.html의 firebaseConfig를 확인해 주세요.`;

        banner.classList.add("show");

      }

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // Firestore Realtime Subscriptions & Writes

    // =========================================================================

    function connectRoom(roomId) {

      unsubs.forEach((u) => { try { u(); } catch {} });

      unsubs = [];

      state.roomId = roomId;

      state.events = [];

      state.doodles = {};

      state.logs = [];

      setSyncStatus("wait");

      const url = new URL(window.location.href);

      if (roomId === "main") url.searchParams.delete("room");

      else url.searchParams.set("room", roomId);

      window.history.replaceState({}, "", url.toString());

      const eventsCol = collection(db, "rooms", roomId, "events");

      const doodlesCol = collection(db, "rooms", roomId, "doodles");

      const logsCol = collection(db, "rooms", roomId, "logs");

      const handleErr = (err) => {

        console.error("Firestore error:", err);

        setSyncStatus("err", err.message || err.code || "권한 또는 네트워크 오류");

      };

      unsubs.push(onSnapshot(eventsCol, (snap) => {

        const arr = [];

        snap.forEach((d) => arr.push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));

        arr.sort((a, b) => (a.startDate || "").localeCompare(b.startDate || "") || (a.createdAtMs || 0) - (b.createdAtMs || 0));

        state.events = arr;

        setSyncStatus("live");

        render();

      }, handleErr));

      unsubs.push(onSnapshot(doodlesCol, (snap) => {

        const map = {};

        snap.forEach((d) => { map[d.id] = d.data(); });

        state.doodles = map;

        render();

      }, handleErr));

      unsubs.push(onSnapshot(query(logsCol, orderBy("createdAtMs", "desc"), limit(80)), (snap) => {

        const arr = [];

        snap.forEach((d) => arr.push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));

        state.logs = arr;

        render();

      }, handleErr));

    }

    async function writeLog({ action, actor, summary, targetDate, detail = "" }) {

      try {

        await addDoc(collection(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "logs"), {

          action,

          actor: actor || state.profile.name || "익명",

          summary,

          detail,

          targetDate: targetDate || todayYMD(),

          createdAtMs: Date.now(),

          createdAt: serverTimestamp()

        });

      } catch (e) {

        console.error("Log write failed:", e);

      }

    }

    function rememberProfile(name, color) {

      if (!name) return;

      const clean = name.trim();

      if (!clean) return;

      if (!state.profile.name) {

        state.profile.name = clean;

        if (color) state.profile.color = color;

      }

      const rec = new Set([clean, ...(state.profile.recentNames || [])]);

      state.profile.recentNames = Array.from(rec).slice(0, 8);

      saveLS("chulta4_profile", state.profile);

    }

    function getPeopleList() {

      const map = new Map();

      for (const ev of state.events) {

        if (!ev.author) continue;

        if (!map.has(ev.author)) {

          map.set(ev.author, ev.color || "#FF6B00");

        }

      }

      if (state.profile.name && !map.has(state.profile.name)) {

        map.set(state.profile.name, state.profile.color || "#FF6B00");

      }

      return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([name, color]) => ({ name, color }));

    }

    function getFilteredEvents() {

      return state.events.filter((ev) => {

        if (state.kindFilter !== "all" && ev.kind !== state.kindFilter) return false;

        if (state.hiddenPeople.has(ev.author)) return false;

        return true;

      });

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // Spanning Calendar Layout Algorithm

    // =========================================================================

    function getMonthWeeks(year, month) {

      const first = new Date(year, month, 1);

      const last = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);

      const start = new Date(first);

      start.setDate(first.getDate() - first.getDay());

      const end = new Date(last);

      end.setDate(last.getDate() + (6 - last.getDay()));

      const weeks = [];

      const cur = new Date(start);

      while (cur <= end) {

        const week = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {

          week.push({

            ymd: toYMD(cur),

            day: cur.getDate(),

            dow: cur.getDay(),

            inMonth: cur.getMonth() === month

          });

          cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);

        }

        weeks.push(week);

      }

      return weeks;

    }

    function layoutWeekEvents(week, events) {

      const wStart = week[0].ymd;

      const wEnd = week[6].ymd;

      const relevant = events.filter((ev) => ev.startDate <= wEnd && ev.endDate >= wStart);

      relevant.sort((a, b) => {

        if (a.kind !== b.kind) return a.kind === "outing" ? -1 : 1;

        const da = diffDays(a.startDate, a.endDate);

        const db = diffDays(b.startDate, b.endDate);

        if (db !== da) return db - da;

        return a.startDate.localeCompare(b.startDate);

      });

      const lanes = [];

      const overflowCounts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];

      const MAX_LANES = 4;

      for (const ev of relevant) {

        const sCol = ev.startDate <= wStart ? 0 : diffDays(wStart, ev.startDate);

        const eCol = ev.endDate >= wEnd ? 6 : diffDays(wStart, ev.endDate);

        let placed = false;

        for (let l = 0; l < lanes.length; l++) {

          let free = true;

          for (let c = sCol; c <= eCol; c++) {

            if (lanes[l].occ[c]) { free = false; break; }

          }

          if (free) {

            for (let c = sCol; c <= eCol; c++) lanes[l].occ[c] = true;

            lanes[l].items.push({

              ev, sCol, eCol,

              contLeft: ev.startDate < wStart,

              contRight: ev.endDate > wEnd

            });

            placed = true;

            break;

          }

        }

        if (!placed) {

          if (lanes.length < MAX_LANES) {

            const occ = Array(7).fill(false);

            for (let c = sCol; c <= eCol; c++) occ[c] = true;

            lanes.push({

              occ,

              items: [{

                ev, sCol, eCol,

                contLeft: ev.startDate < wStart,

                contRight: ev.endDate > wEnd

              }]

            });

          } else {

            for (let c = sCol; c <= eCol; c++) overflowCounts[c]++;

          }

        }

      }

      return { lanes, overflowCounts };

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // Render Functions

    // =========================================================================

    function updateTabBadges() {

      const today = todayYMD();

      const activeOutings = state.events.filter((e) => e.kind === "outing" && e.startDate <= today && e.endDate >= today);

      const upcomingOutings = state.events.filter((e) => e.kind === "outing" && e.startDate > today);

      const bDday = document.getElementById("badge-dday");

      if (bDday) bDday.textContent = activeOutings.length > 0 ? `NOW ${activeOutings.length}` : (upcomingOutings.length ? `${upcomingOutings.length}` : "");

      const bAct = document.getElementById("badge-activity");

      if (bAct) bAct.textContent = state.logs.length ? `${Math.min(state.logs.length, 99)}` : "";

      document.querySelectorAll(".nav-tab").forEach((t) => {

        t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.tab === state.tab);

      });

      const fab = document.getElementById("fab-add");

      if (fab) fab.style.display = (state.tab === "calendar" || state.tab === "dday") ? "inline-flex" : "none";

    }

    function renderMiniTicker() {

      const today = todayYMD();

      const outings = state.events.filter((e) => e.kind === "outing");

      const activeNow = outings.filter((e) => e.startDate <= today && e.endDate >= today);

      const mine = state.profile.name;

      // Prioritize my active -> any active -> my next -> any next

      const myActive = mine ? activeNow.find((e) => e.author === mine) : null;

      const upcoming = outings.filter((e) => e.startDate > today).sort((a, b) => a.startDate.localeCompare(b.startDate));

      const myNext = mine ? upcoming.find((e) => e.author === mine) : null;

      let tag = "D-DAY";

      let text = "등록된 출타 일정이 없습니다 · + 버튼으로 추가해 보세요";

      if (myActive) {

        const left = diffDays(today, myActive.endDate);

        tag = left === 0 ? "오늘 복귀" : `복귀 D-${left}`;

        text = `${myActive.author} · ${myActive.title || myActive.subtype} (${fmtRange(myActive.startDate, myActive.endDate)})`;

      } else if (myNext) {

        const left = diffDays(today, myNext.startDate);

        tag = `출타 D-${left}`;

        text = `${myNext.author} · ${myNext.title || myNext.subtype} (${fmtShort(myNext.startDate)} · ${fmtDuration(myNext.startDate, myNext.endDate)})`;

      } else if (activeNow.length > 0) {

        const first = activeNow[0];

        const left = diffDays(today, first.endDate);

        tag = left === 0 ? "오늘 복귀" : `복귀 D-${left}`;

        text = `${first.author} · ${first.title || first.subtype}`;

      } else if (upcoming.length > 0) {

        const first = upcoming[0];

        const left = diffDays(today, first.startDate);

        tag = `출타 D-${left}`;

        text = `${first.author} · ${first.title || first.subtype} (${fmtShort(first.startDate)})`;

      }

      const rightText = activeNow.length > 0 ? `오늘 출타 ${activeNow.length}명 ›` : `디데이 ›`;

      return `

        <div class="dday-ticker" id="mini-ticker">

          <div class="ticker-left">

            <span class="ticker-tag tabular">${esc(tag)}</span>

            <span class="ticker-text">${esc(text)}</span>

          </div>

          <span class="ticker-right tabular">${esc(rightText)}</span>

        </div>

      `;

    }

    function renderFilterBar() {

      const people = getPeopleList();

      const allSelected = people.length > 0 && state.hiddenPeople.size === 0;

      const noneSelected = people.length > 0 && people.every((p) => state.hiddenPeople.has(p.name));

      const myName = state.profile.name;

      const isOnlyMine = myName && people.some((p) => p.name === myName) && !state.hiddenPeople.has(myName) &&

        people.filter((p) => p.name !== myName).every((p) => state.hiddenPeople.has(p.name));

      const personChips = people.map((p) => {

        const isOff = state.hiddenPeople.has(p.name);

        return `

          <button class="chip ${isOff ? "person-off" : "selected"}" data-action="toggle-person" data-person="${esc(p.name)}" type="button">

            <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(p.color)}"></span>

            ${esc(p.name)}

          </button>

        `;

      }).join("");

      return `

        <div class="filter-section">

          <div class="chip-row">

            <button class="chip ${state.kindFilter === "all" ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="kind-filter" data-val="all" type="button">전체</button>

            <button class="chip ${state.kindFilter === "outing" ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="kind-filter" data-val="outing" type="button">출타만</button>

            <button class="chip ${state.kindFilter === "work" ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="kind-filter" data-val="work" type="button">알바·개인</button>

            <span class="chip-divider"></span>

            <button class="chip ${state.showDoodles ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="toggle-doodles" type="button">낙서 ${state.showDoodles ? "ON" : "OFF"}</button>

            <button class="chip" data-action="copy-month-text" type="button">월간 요약 복사</button>

          </div>

          ${people.length > 0 ? `

          <div class="chip-row">

            <button class="chip ${allSelected ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="people-all" type="button">모두 선택</button>

            <button class="chip ${noneSelected ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="people-none" type="button">모두 해제</button>

            ${myName ? `<button class="chip ${isOnlyMine ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="people-mine" type="button">내 일정만</button>` : ""}

            <span class="chip-divider"></span>

            ${personChips}

          </div>` : ""}

        </div>

      `;

    }

    function renderMonthGrid(year, month, events, showHeader = false) {

      const weeks = getMonthWeeks(year, month);

      const today = todayYMD();

      const headerHtml = showHeader ? `

        <div class="scroll-month-header tabular">

          <span>${year}년 ${month + 1}월</span>

          <span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-3);font-weight:600;">${events.filter((e) => {

            const mStr = `${year}-${pad2(month + 1)}`;

            return e.startDate.slice(0, 7) <= mStr && e.endDate.slice(0, 7) >= mStr;

          }).length}건</span>

        </div>

      ` : "";

      const weeksHtml = weeks.map((week) => {

        const { lanes, overflowCounts } = layoutWeekEvents(week, events);

        const bgCells = week.map((d) => {

          const doodle = state.doodles[d.ymd];

          const hasImg = state.showDoodles && doodle && doodle.image;

          return `

            <div class="day-bg-cell ${d.inMonth ? "" : "other-month"} ${d.ymd === state.selectedDay ? "selected-day" : ""}" data-day="${d.ymd}">

              ${hasImg ? `<img class="doodle-thumb" src="${doodle.image}" alt="" />` : ""}

            </div>

          `;

        }).join("");

        const numCells = week.map((d) => {

          const doodle = state.doodles[d.ymd];

          const hasNote = doodle && (doodle.image || (doodle.memo && doodle.memo.trim()));

          const dowCls = d.dow === 0 ? "sun" : (d.dow === 6 ? "sat" : "");

          return `

            <div class="day-num-wrap">

              <span class="day-num tabular ${dowCls} ${d.inMonth ? "" : "other"} ${d.ymd === today ? "today" : ""}">${d.day}</span>

              ${hasNote ? `<span class="day-note-dot" title="메모/낙서 있음"></span>` : ""}

            </div>

          `;

        }).join("");

        const lanesHtml = lanes.map((lane) => {

          const bars = lane.items.map(({ ev, sCol, eCol, contLeft, contRight }) => {

            const color = ev.color || "#FF6B00";

            const kindCls = ev.kind === "work" ? "kind-work" : "kind-outing";

            const draftCls = ev.status === "draft" ? "is-draft" : "";

            const labelText = ev.kind === "work"

              ? `${ev.author}${ev.startTime ? " " + ev.startTime.slice(0, 5) : ""} ${ev.title || ev.subtype || ""}`.trim()

              : `${ev.author} ${ev.title || ev.subtype || ""}`.trim();

            return `

              <div class="ev-bar ${kindCls} ${draftCls} ${contLeft ? "cont-left" : ""} ${contRight ? "cont-right" : ""}"

                   style="grid-column: ${sCol + 1} / ${eCol + 2}; background:${esc(color)}; --ev-color:${esc(color)};"

                   data-ev-id="${esc(ev.id)}"

                   title="${esc(labelText)}">

                ${ev.status === "draft" ? `<span style="opacity:.85">[가안]</span>` : ""}

                <span>${esc(labelText)}</span>

              </div>

            `;

          }).join("");

          return `<div class="bar-lane">${bars}</div>`;

        }).join("");

        const hasOverflow = overflowCounts.some((n) => n > 0);

        const overflowHtml = hasOverflow ? `

          <div class="more-row">

            ${overflowCounts.map((n) => `<div class="more-cell tabular">${n > 0 ? `+${n}` : ""}</div>`).join("")}

          </div>

        ` : "";

        return `

          <div class="week-row">

            <div class="week-bg-grid">${bgCells}</div>

            <div class="week-header-grid">${numCells}</div>

            <div class="week-bars">${lanesHtml}</div>

            ${overflowHtml}

          </div>

        `;

      }).join("");

      return `

        <div class="cal-month-block">

          ${headerHtml}

          <div class="weekday-row">

            ${WEEKDAYS.map((w, i) => `<div class="weekday-cell ${i === 0 ? "sun" : (i === 6 ? "sat" : "")}">${w}</div>`).join("")}

          </div>

          ${weeksHtml}

        </div>

      `;

    }

    function renderCalendarTab() {

      const filtered = getFilteredEvents();

      let bodyHtml = "";

      if (state.viewMode === "month") {

        bodyHtml = `

          <div class="cal-toolbar">

            <div class="month-nav">

              <button class="btn-ghost icon-only" data-action="prev-month" type="button" aria-label="이전 달">‹</button>

              <div class="month-title tabular">${state.calYear}.${pad2(state.calMonth + 1)}</div>

              <button class="btn-ghost icon-only" data-action="next-month" type="button" aria-label="다음 달">›</button>

              <button class="btn-ghost" data-action="go-today" type="button">오늘</button>

            </div>

            <div class="seg-control">

              <button class="seg-btn active" data-action="set-view" data-val="month" type="button">월간</button>

              <button class="seg-btn" data-action="set-view" data-val="scroll" type="button">스크롤</button>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div id="cal-swipe-zone">

            ${renderMonthGrid(state.calYear, state.calMonth, filtered, false)}

          </div>

        `;

      } else {

        const blocks = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < state.scrollMonthsCount; i++) {

          const d = new Date(state.calYear, state.calMonth + state.scrollOffsetStart + i, 1);

          blocks.push(renderMonthGrid(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), filtered, true));

        }

        bodyHtml = `

          <div class="cal-toolbar">

            <div class="month-nav">

              <button class="btn-ghost" data-action="scroll-prev-more" type="button">이전 달 추가</button>

              <button class="btn-ghost" data-action="go-today" type="button">오늘 기준</button>

            </div>

            <div class="seg-control">

              <button class="seg-btn" data-action="set-view" data-val="month" type="button">월간</button>

              <button class="seg-btn active" data-action="set-view" data-val="scroll" type="button">스크롤</button>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div>${blocks.join("")}</div>

          <div style="padding: 8px 16px 14px; text-align:center;">

            <button class="btn-ghost" style="width:100%;height:38px;" data-action="scroll-next-more" type="button">다음 달 더 보기 (+2개월)</button>

          </div>

        `;

      }

      return `

        ${renderMiniTicker()}

        ${renderFilterBar()}

        ${bodyHtml}

        <div class="cal-hint">

          <span>날짜 탭: 상세·낙서 · 길게 누르기: 빠른 등록</span>

          <span>채워진 바: 출타 · 점선: 가안 · 좌측선: 알바</span>

        </div>

      `;

    }

    function renderDdayTab() {

      const today = todayYMD();

      const allOutings = state.events.filter((e) => e.kind === "outing");

      const peopleMap = new Map();

      allOutings.forEach((e) => { if (e.author && !peopleMap.has(e.author)) peopleMap.set(e.author, e.color || "#FF6B00"); });

      const people = Array.from(peopleMap.entries()).map(([name, color]) => ({ name, color }));

      const myName = state.profile.name;

      const filtered = allOutings.filter((e) => !state.ddayHiddenPeople.has(e.author));

      const active = filtered.filter((e) => e.startDate <= today && e.endDate >= today).sort((a, b) => a.endDate.localeCompare(b.endDate));

      const upcoming = filtered.filter((e) => e.startDate > today).sort((a, b) => a.startDate.localeCompare(b.startDate));

      const past = filtered.filter((e) => e.endDate < today).sort((a, b) => b.endDate.localeCompare(a.endDate));

      // Compute gap from each person's previous outing return date

      const lastReturnByAuthor = new Map();

      for (const e of [...past].reverse()) {

        lastReturnByAuthor.set(e.author, e.endDate);

      }

      for (const e of active) {

        lastReturnByAuthor.set(e.author, e.endDate);

      }

      const activeHtml = active.map((e) => {

        const total = Math.max(1, diffDays(e.startDate, e.endDate) + 1);

        const elapsed = Math.min(total, diffDays(e.startDate, today) + 1);

        const pct = Math.round((elapsed / total) * 100);

        const left = diffDays(today, e.endDate);

        return `

          <div class="card" style="cursor:pointer;border-left:3px solid ${esc(e.color || "#FF6B00")}" data-ev-id="${esc(e.id)}">

            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;">

              <div>

                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">

                  <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(e.color || "#FF6B00")}"></span>

                  <strong style="font-size:14.5px;">${esc(e.author)}</strong>

                  <span class="pill">${esc(e.subtype || "출타")}</span>

                  ${e.status === "draft" ? `<span class="pill draft">가안</span>` : ""}

                </div>

                <div style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;">${esc(e.title || e.subtype)}</div>

                <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2);margin-top:2px;" class="tabular">${fmtRange(e.startDate, e.endDate)} · ${fmtDuration(e.startDate, e.endDate)}</div>

              </div>

              <div style="text-align:right;">

                <div class="dday-num tabular">${left === 0 ? "D-DAY" : `복귀 D-${left}`}</div>

                <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);" class="tabular">${elapsed}/${total}일차 (${pct}%)</div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${esc(e.color || "#FF6B00")}"></div></div>

          </div>

        `;

      }).join("");

      const upcomingHtml = upcoming.map((e) => {

        const dLeft = diffDays(today, e.startDate);

        const prevRet = lastReturnByAuthor.get(e.author);

        let gapHtml = "";

        if (prevRet) {

          const gap = diffDays(prevRet, e.startDate);

          if (gap > 0) {

            gapHtml = `<div class="gap-badge tabular">${esc(e.author)} · 이전 복귀 후 ${gap}일 만에 출타</div>`;

          }

        }

        lastReturnByAuthor.set(e.author, e.endDate);

        return `

          ${gapHtml}

          <div class="card" style="cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;border-left:3px solid ${esc(e.color || "#FF6B00")}" data-ev-id="${esc(e.id)}">

            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;">

              <div style="min-width:0;">

                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

                  <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(e.color || "#FF6B00")}"></span>

                  <strong style="font-size:14px;">${esc(e.author)}</strong>

                  <span class="pill">${esc(e.subtype || "출타")}</span>

                  <span class="pill tabular">${fmtDuration(e.startDate, e.endDate)}</span>

                  ${e.status === "draft" ? `<span class="pill draft">가안</span>` : ""}

                </div>

                <div style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${esc(e.title || e.subtype)}</div>

                <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2);margin-top:2px;" class="tabular">${fmtRange(e.startDate, e.endDate)}</div>

              </div>

              <div class="dday-num tabular">D-${dLeft}</div>

            </div>

          </div>

        `;

      }).join("");

      const allSel = people.length > 0 && state.ddayHiddenPeople.size === 0;

      const onlyMine = myName && people.some((p) => p.name === myName) && !state.ddayHiddenPeople.has(myName) &&

        people.filter((p) => p.name !== myName).every((p) => state.ddayHiddenPeople.has(p.name));

      return `

        <div class="page-body">

          ${people.length > 0 ? `

          <div class="chip-row">

            <button class="chip ${allSel ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="dday-all" type="button">전체</button>

            ${myName ? `<button class="chip ${onlyMine ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="dday-mine" type="button">내 디데이만</button>` : ""}

            <span class="chip-divider"></span>

            ${people.map((p) => `

              <button class="chip ${state.ddayHiddenPeople.has(p.name) ? "person-off" : "selected"}" data-action="dday-toggle-person" data-person="${esc(p.name)}" type="button">

                <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(p.color)}"></span>

                ${esc(p.name)}

              </button>

            `).join("")}

          </div>` : ""}

          ${allOutings.length === 0 ? `

            <div class="empty-state">

              <div class="empty-title">등록된 출타 일정이 없습니다</div>

              <div class="empty-sub">휴가·외박·외출 일정을 등록하면 출타·복귀 디데이와 출타 간격이 자동으로 계산됩니다.</div>

              <button class="btn-accent" data-action="open-add-outing" type="button">+ 첫 출타 등록하기</button>

            </div>

          ` : `

            <div>

              <div class="section-label"><span>현재 출타 중</span><span class="tabular">${active.length}건</span></div>

              ${active.length ? `<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">${activeHtml}</div>` : `<div class="card" style="color:var(--text-3);font-size:12.5px;">오늘 밖에 나와 있는 출타 인원이 없습니다.</div>`}

            </div>

            <div>

              <div class="section-label"><span>다가오는 출타</span><span class="tabular">${upcoming.length}건</span></div>

              ${upcoming.length ? upcomingHtml : `<div class="card" style="color:var(--text-3);font-size:12.5px;">예정된 출타 일정이 없습니다.</div>`}

            </div>

            ${past.length > 0 ? `

            <div>

              <div class="section-label">

                <span>지난 출타 기록 (${past.length}건)</span>

                <button class="btn-ghost" style="height:26px;font-size:11px;" data-action="toggle-past" type="button">${state.showPastOutings ? "접기" : "펼치기"}</button>

              </div>

              ${state.showPastOutings ? `

                <div class="card-list">

                  ${past.map((e) => `

                    <div class="list-item" data-ev-id="${esc(e.id)}">

                      <div>

                        <div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;">${esc(e.author)} · ${esc(e.title || e.subtype)}</div>

                        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);" class="tabular">${fmtRange(e.startDate, e.endDate)} (${fmtDuration(e.startDate, e.endDate)})</div>

                      </div>

                      <span class="dday-num muted tabular">D+${diffDays(e.endDate, today)}</span>

                    </div>

                  `).join("")}

                </div>

              ` : ""}

            </div>` : ""}

          `}

        </div>

      `;

    }

    function computeRecommendations() {

      const startBase = addDays(todayYMD(), 1);

      const myName = state.profile.name;

      const daysLen = state.recDays;

      const candidates = [];

      for (let offset = 0; offset < state.recHorizon; offset++) {

        const s = addDays(startBase, offset);

        const e = addDays(s, daysLen - 1);

        const outPeople = new Set();

        const workPeople = new Set();

        let targetOutOverlapDays = 0;

        let targetWorkConflictDays = 0;

        let myConflict = false;

        let weekendDays = 0;

        for (let k = 0; k < daysLen; k++) {

          const cur = addDays(s, k);

          const dow = parseYMD(cur).getDay();

          if (dow === 0 || dow === 6) weekendDays++;

          for (const ev of state.events) {

            if (ev.startDate <= cur && ev.endDate >= cur) {

              if (myName && ev.author === myName) myConflict = true;

              const isTarget = state.recTargets.size === 0 || state.recTargets.has(ev.author);

              if (ev.author !== myName) {

                if (ev.kind === "outing") {

                  outPeople.add(ev.author);

                  if (isTarget) targetOutOverlapDays++;

                } else {

                  workPeople.add(ev.author);

                  if (isTarget) targetWorkConflictDays++;

                }

              }

            }

          }

        }

        if (myConflict) continue;

        let score = 0;

        if (state.recStrategy === "max_meet") {

          score = outPeople.size * 30 + targetOutOverlapDays * 10 - workPeople.size * 12 - targetWorkConflictDays * 4 + weekendDays * 4;

        } else if (state.recStrategy === "target_people") {

          score = targetOutOverlapDays * 25 - targetWorkConflictDays * 18 + weekendDays * 3;

        } else {

          // quiet

          score = 100 - (outPeople.size * 20 + workPeople.size * 15) - weekendDays * 2;

        }

        candidates.push({

          startDate: s,

          endDate: e,

          score,

          outPeople: Array.from(outPeople),

          workPeople: Array.from(workPeople),

          weekendDays

        });

      }

      candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.startDate.localeCompare(b.startDate));

      // Pick top 5 non-overlapping (or spaced by at least 2 days)

      const picked = [];

      for (const c of candidates) {

        if (picked.length >= 5) break;

        const tooClose = picked.some((p) => Math.abs(diffDays(p.startDate, c.startDate)) < Math.max(2, Math.floor(daysLen / 2)));

        if (!tooClose) picked.push(c);

      }

      return picked;

    }

    function renderRecommendTab() {

      const people = getPeopleList().filter((p) => p.name !== state.profile.name);

      const recs = computeRecommendations();

      return `

        <div class="page-body">

          <div class="card">

            <div class="field">

              <div class="field-label"><span>희망 출타 기간</span></div>

              <div class="grid-3">

                ${[2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((d) => `

                  <button class="opt-btn ${state.recDays === d ? "active" : ""}" data-action="rec-days" data-val="${d}" type="button">${d - 1}박 ${d}일</button>

                `).join("")}

                <button class="opt-btn ${state.recDays === 1 ? "active" : ""}" data-action="rec-days" data-val="1" type="button">당일 외출</button>

              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="field">

              <div class="field-label"><span>추천 전략</span></div>

              <div class="grid-3">

                <button class="opt-btn ${state.recStrategy === "max_meet" ? "active" : ""}" data-action="rec-strategy" data-val="max_meet" type="button">최대 만남</button>

                <button class="opt-btn ${state.recStrategy === "target_people" ? "active" : ""}" data-action="rec-strategy" data-val="target_people" type="button">특정인 맞춤</button>

                <button class="opt-btn ${state.recStrategy === "quiet" ? "active" : ""}" data-action="rec-strategy" data-val="quiet" type="button">한적한 날</button>

              </div>

            </div>

            ${state.recStrategy === "target_people" ? `

            <div class="field">

              <div class="field-label"><span>맞출 지인 선택 (출타 겹침↑ / 알바 회피)</span></div>

              ${people.length ? `

                <div class="chip-row">

                  ${people.map((p) => `

                    <button class="chip ${state.recTargets.has(p.name) ? "selected" : ""}" data-action="rec-toggle-target" data-person="${esc(p.name)}" type="button">

                      <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(p.color)}"></span>

                      ${esc(p.name)}

                    </button>

                  `).join("")}

                </div>

              ` : `<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);">다른 지인의 일정이 등록되면 여기서 선택할 수 있습니다.</div>`}

            </div>` : ""}

            <div class="field">

              <div class="field-label"><span>탐색 범위</span></div>

              <div class="grid-3">

                ${[30, 60, 90].map((h) => `

                  <button class="opt-btn ${state.recHorizon === h ? "active" : ""}" data-action="rec-horizon" data-val="${h}" type="button">향후 ${h}일</button>

                `).join("")}

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div>

            <div class="section-label"><span>추천 날짜 Top ${recs.length}</span><span class="tabular">${fmtDuration(todayYMD(), addDays(todayYMD(), state.recDays - 1))} 기준</span></div>

            ${recs.length === 0 ? `

              <div class="empty-state">

                <div class="empty-title">조건에 맞는 빈 기간이 없습니다</div>

                <div class="empty-sub">탐색 범위를 넓히거나 기간을 조정해 보세요.</div>

              </div>

            ` : `

              <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">

                ${recs.map((r, idx) => `

                  <div class="card">

                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;">

                      <div>

                        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">

                          <span class="pill accent tabular">#${idx + 1}</span>

                          <strong style="font-size:14.5px;" class="tabular">${fmtRange(r.startDate, r.endDate)}</strong>

                        </div>

                        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-2);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;">

                          <span>출타 겹침: ${r.outPeople.length ? esc(r.outPeople.join(", ")) : "없음"}</span>

                          <span>알바·개인 일정: ${r.workPeople.length ? esc(r.workPeople.join(", ")) : "없음"} · 주말 ${r.weekendDays}일 포함</span>

                        </div>

                      </div>

                      <span class="pill tabular">D-${diffDays(todayYMD(), r.startDate)}</span>

                    </div>

                    <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top:10px;">

                      <button class="btn-ghost" data-action="rec-apply" data-start="${r.startDate}" data-end="${r.endDate}" data-status="draft" type="button">가안으로 등록</button>

                      <button class="btn-accent" data-action="rec-apply" data-start="${r.startDate}" data-end="${r.endDate}" data-status="confirmed" type="button">확정 등록</button>

                    </div>

                  </div>

                `).join("")}

              </div>

            `}

          </div>

        </div>

      `;

    }

    function renderActivityTab() {

      const actionLabels = {

        CREATE: "등록",

        UPDATE: "수정",

        DELETE: "삭제",

        COMMENT: "댓글",

        RSVP: "반응",

        DOODLE: "메모·낙서"

      };

      const logsBody = state.logs.length === 0 ? `

        <div class="empty-state">

          <div class="empty-title">아직 기록된 활동이 없습니다</div>

          <div class="empty-sub">누군가 일정을 추가·변경하거나 댓글·낙서를 남기면 실시간으로 여기에 쌓입니다.</div>

        </div>

      ` : `

        <div class="card-list">

          ${state.logs.map((log) => `

            <div class="list-item" data-action="jump-date" data-date="${esc(log.targetDate || todayYMD())}">

              <div style="min-width:0;flex:1;">

                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:4px;">

                  <span class="pill ${log.action === "CREATE" ? "accent" : ""}">${actionLabels[log.action] || log.action}</span>

                  <strong style="font-size:13px;">${esc(log.actor)}</strong>

                  <span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-3);" class="tabular">${fmtRelative(log.createdAtMs)}</span>

                </div>

                <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text);word-break:break-word;">${esc(log.summary)}</div>

                ${log.detail ? `<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-2);margin-top:3px;">${esc(log.detail)}</div>` : ""}

              </div>

              <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);flex-shrink:0;" class="tabular">${log.targetDate ? fmtShort(log.targetDate) : ""}</span>

            </div>

          `).join("")}

        </div>

      `;

      const changelogBody = `

        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;">

          ${CHANGELOGS.map((cl, idx) => `

            <div class="card">

              <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px;">

                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;">

                  <span class="pill ${idx === 0 ? "accent" : ""} tabular">${esc(cl.version)}</span>

                  <strong style="font-size:14px;">${esc(cl.title)}</strong>

                </div>

                <span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-3);" class="tabular">${esc(cl.date)}</span>

              </div>

              <ul style="margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--text-2);font-size:12.5px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;">

                ${cl.items.map((it) => `<li>${esc(it)}</li>`).join("")}

              </ul>

            </div>

          `).join("")}

        </div>

      `;

      return `

        <div class="page-body">

          <div class="seg-control" style="width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;">

            <button class="seg-btn ${state.activitySub === "logs" ? "active" : ""}" style="padding:8px;" data-action="activity-sub" data-val="logs" type="button">최근 변경사항</button>

            <button class="seg-btn ${state.activitySub === "changelog" ? "active" : ""}" style="padding:8px;" data-action="activity-sub" data-val="changelog" type="button">업데이트 노트</button>

          </div>

          ${state.activitySub === "logs" ? logsBody : changelogBody}

        </div>

      `;

    }
