    function render() {

      applyTheme();

      updateTabBadges();

      const main = document.getElementById("app-main");

      if (state.tab === "calendar") main.innerHTML = renderCalendarTab();

      else if (state.tab === "dday") main.innerHTML = renderDdayTab();

      else if (state.tab === "recommend") main.innerHTML = renderRecommendTab();

      else if (state.tab === "activity") main.innerHTML = renderActivityTab();

      else if (state.tab === "settings") main.innerHTML = renderSettingsTab();

      if (state.tab === "calendar" && state.viewMode === "month") {

        attachSwipeHandlers();

      }

      attachDayLongPress();

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // Touch Swipe (Month Switch) & Long Press (Quick Add)

    // =========================================================================

    function attachSwipeHandlers() {

      const zone = document.getElementById("cal-swipe-zone");

      if (!zone) return;

      let sx = 0, sy = 0, st = 0;

      zone.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {

        if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;

        sx = e.touches[0].clientX;

        sy = e.touches[0].clientY;

        st = Date.now();

      }, { passive: true });

      zone.addEventListener("touchend", (e) => {

        if (e.changedTouches.length !== 1) return;

        const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - sx;

        const dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - sy;

        const dt = Date.now() - st;

        if (dt < 420 && Math.abs(dx) > 58 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.4) {

          shiftMonth(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1);

        }

      }, { passive: true });

    }

    let longPressTimer = null;

    let longPressFired = false;

    function attachDayLongPress() {

      const cells = document.querySelectorAll(".day-bg-cell[data-day]");

      cells.forEach((cell) => {

        const ymd = cell.dataset.day;

        const start = () => {

          longPressFired = false;

          clearTimeout(longPressTimer);

          longPressTimer = setTimeout(() => {

            longPressFired = true;

            if (navigator.vibrate) try { navigator.vibrate(18); } catch {}

            openEventFormSheet({ startDate: ymd, endDate: ymd });

          }, 460);

        };

        const cancel = () => clearTimeout(longPressTimer);

        cell.addEventListener("touchstart", start, { passive: true });

        cell.addEventListener("touchmove", cancel, { passive: true });

        cell.addEventListener("touchend", cancel, { passive: true });

        cell.addEventListener("mousedown", start);

        cell.addEventListener("mouseleave", cancel);

        cell.addEventListener("mouseup", cancel);

      });

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // Bottom Sheet Modal Helpers

    // =========================================================================

    function openSheet(title, html) {

      document.getElementById("sheet-title").textContent = title;

      document.getElementById("sheet-body").innerHTML = html;

      document.getElementById("sheet-backdrop").classList.add("open");

    }

    function closeSheet() {

      document.getElementById("sheet-backdrop").classList.remove("open");

    }

    // 1. Date Detail & Doodle Sheet

    function openDaySheet(ymd) {

      state.selectedDay = ymd;

      const dayEvents = getFilteredEvents().filter((e) => e.startDate <= ymd && e.endDate >= ymd);

      const doodle = state.doodles[ymd] || {};

      const listHtml = dayEvents.length === 0 ? `

        <div style="padding:18px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-3);font-size:12.5px;border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:14px;">

          이 날짜에 등록된 일정이 없습니다.

        </div>

      ` : `

        <div class="card-list" style="margin-bottom:14px;">

          ${dayEvents.map((ev) => `

            <div class="list-item" data-sheet-ev-id="${esc(ev.id)}">

              <div style="min-width:0;">

                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

                  <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(ev.color || "#FF6B00")}"></span>

                  <strong style="font-size:13.5px;">${esc(ev.author)}</strong>

                  <span class="pill">${esc(ev.subtype || (ev.kind === "outing" ? "출타" : "일정"))}</span>

                  ${ev.status === "draft" ? `<span class="pill draft">가안</span>` : ""}

                </div>

                <div style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;">${esc(ev.title || ev.subtype)}</div>

                <div style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-2);margin-top:2px;" class="tabular">

                  ${fmtRange(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)} (${fmtDuration(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)})

                  ${ev.startTime ? ` · ${ev.startTime}${ev.endTime ? "~" + ev.endTime : ""}` : ""}

                </div>

              </div>

              <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);">상세 ›</span>

            </div>

          `).join("")}

        </div>

      `;

      openSheet(`${ymd} (${WEEKDAYS[parseYMD(ymd).getDay()]})`, `

        <div style="margin-bottom:12px;">

          <button class="btn-accent lg" id="sheet-add-day-ev" type="button">+ 이 날짜에 일정 추가</button>

        </div>

        ${listHtml}

        <div class="section-label"><span>날짜 메모 & 달력 낙서</span></div>

        <div class="field">

          <input class="input" id="day-memo-input" type="text" placeholder="짧은 메모를 남겨보세요 (예: 저녁 구리에서 모임)" value="${esc(doodle.memo || "")}" />

        </div>

        <div class="canvas-box">

          <canvas class="doodle-canvas" id="doodle-canvas"></canvas>

          <div class="canvas-tools">

            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">

              ${["#FF6B00", "#EFF2F6", "#38BDF8", "#4ADE80", "#F43F5E", "#FACC15"].map((c, idx) => `

                <button class="pen-dot ${idx === 0 ? "active" : ""}" style="background:${c}" data-pen-color="${c}" type="button"></button>

              `).join("")}

            </div>

            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;">

              <button class="btn-ghost" id="btn-pen-size" type="button">굵기: 중</button>

              <button class="btn-ghost" id="btn-canvas-clear" type="button">지우기</button>

              <button class="btn-accent" id="btn-canvas-save" type="button">저장</button>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      `);

      document.getElementById("sheet-add-day-ev").onclick = () => openEventFormSheet({ startDate: ymd, endDate: ymd });

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-sheet-ev-id]").forEach((el) => {

        el.onclick = () => openEventDetailSheet(el.dataset.sheetEvId);

      });

      // Initialize interactive high-DPI doodle canvas

      const canvas = document.getElementById("doodle-canvas");

      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

      canvas.width = Math.max(300, Math.round(rect.width * dpr));

      canvas.height = Math.round(220 * dpr);

      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

      ctx.lineCap = "round";

      ctx.lineJoin = "round";

      let hasStroke = false;

      if (doodle.image) {

        const img = new Image();

        img.onload = () => {

          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, rect.width, 220);

          hasStroke = true;

        };

        img.src = doodle.image;

      }

      let penColor = "#FF6B00";

      const sizes = [{ label: "얇게", px: 2.2 }, { label: "중", px: 4 }, { label: "굵게", px: 7.5 }];

      let sizeIdx = 1;

      let drawing = false;

      const getPos = (e) => {

        const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

        const pt = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;

        return { x: pt.clientX - r.left, y: pt.clientY - r.top };

      };

      const startDraw = (e) => {

        e.preventDefault();

        drawing = true;

        hasStroke = true;

        const p = getPos(e);

        ctx.strokeStyle = penColor;

        ctx.lineWidth = sizes[sizeIdx].px;

        ctx.beginPath();

        ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);

      };

      const moveDraw = (e) => {

        if (!drawing) return;

        e.preventDefault();

        const p = getPos(e);

        ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);

        ctx.stroke();

      };

      const endDraw = () => { drawing = false; };

      canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", startDraw);

      canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", moveDraw);

      window.addEventListener("mouseup", endDraw, { once: false });

      canvas.addEventListener("touchstart", startDraw, { passive: false });

      canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", moveDraw, { passive: false });

      canvas.addEventListener("touchend", endDraw);

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-pen-color]").forEach((btn) => {

        btn.onclick = () => {

          penColor = btn.dataset.penColor;

          document.querySelectorAll("[data-pen-color]").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("active"));

          btn.classList.add("active");

        };

      });

      document.getElementById("btn-pen-size").onclick = (e) => {

        sizeIdx = (sizeIdx + 1) % sizes.length;

        e.target.textContent = `굵기: ${sizes[sizeIdx].label}`;

      };

      document.getElementById("btn-canvas-clear").onclick = () => {

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        hasStroke = false;

      };

      document.getElementById("btn-canvas-save").onclick = async () => {

        const memo = document.getElementById("day-memo-input").value.trim();

        const imgData = hasStroke ? canvas.toDataURL("image/png") : "";

        const ref = doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "doodles", ymd);

        try {

          if (!memo && !imgData) {

            await deleteDoc(ref);

            showToast("날짜 메모·낙서를 비웠습니다");

          } else {

            await setDoc(ref, {

              memo,

              image: imgData,

              updatedBy: state.profile.name || "익명",

              updatedAtMs: Date.now()

            });

            await writeLog({

              action: "DOODLE",

              actor: state.profile.name || "익명",

              summary: `${fmtShort(ymd)}에 ${imgData && memo ? "메모와 낙서" : (imgData ? "낙서" : `메모("${memo.slice(0, 24)}")`)}를 남겼습니다.`,

              targetDate: ymd

            });

            showToast("메모·낙서가 실시간 저장되었습니다");

          }

          closeSheet();

        } catch (err) {

          showToast("저장 실패: " + (err.message || "오류"));

        }

      };

    }

    // 2. Event Form Sheet (Create / Edit)

    function openEventFormSheet(prefill = {}) {

      const isEdit = Boolean(prefill.id);

      const formState = {

        id: prefill.id || null,

        kind: prefill.kind || "outing",

        status: prefill.status || "confirmed",

        author: prefill.author || state.profile.name || "",

        subtype: prefill.subtype || (prefill.kind === "work" ? "알바" : "정기휴가"),

        title: prefill.title || "",

        startDate: prefill.startDate || state.selectedDay || todayYMD(),

        endDate: prefill.endDate || prefill.startDate || state.selectedDay || todayYMD(),

        startTime: prefill.startTime || "",

        endTime: prefill.endTime || "",

        color: prefill.color || state.profile.color || "#FF6B00",

        note: prefill.note || "",

        repeatWeeks: 1

      };

      function renderForm() {

        const subtypes = formState.kind === "outing" ? OUTING_SUBTYPES : WORK_SUBTYPES;

        const curDays = diffDays(formState.startDate, formState.endDate) + 1;

        const recentChips = (state.profile.recentNames || []).filter((n) => n !== formState.author).slice(0, 5);

        openSheet(isEdit ? "일정 수정" : "새 일정 등록", `

          <div class="field">

            <div class="grid-2">

              <button class="opt-btn ${formState.kind === "outing" ? "active" : ""}" data-f-kind="outing" type="button">군 출타 (휴가·외박·외출)</button>

              <button class="opt-btn ${formState.kind === "work" ? "active" : ""}" data-f-kind="work" type="button">알바 · 개인 일정</button>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="field">

            <div class="field-label"><span>상태 구분</span></div>

            <div class="grid-2">

              <button class="opt-btn ${formState.status === "confirmed" ? "active" : ""}" data-f-status="confirmed" type="button">확정 일정 (실선)</button>

              <button class="opt-btn ${formState.status === "draft" ? "active" : ""}" data-f-status="draft" type="button">가안 / 조율 중 (점선)</button>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="field">

            <label class="field-label" for="f-author"><span>이름 (대상자)</span></label>

            <input class="input" id="f-author" type="text" maxlength="16" placeholder="예: 오지호" value="${esc(formState.author)}" />

            ${recentChips.length ? `

              <div class="chip-row" style="margin-top:4px;">

                ${recentChips.map((n) => `<button class="chip" data-f-pick-name="${esc(n)}" type="button">${esc(n)}</button>`).join("")}

              </div>

            ` : ""}

          </div>

          <div class="field">

            <div class="field-label"><span>유형</span></div>

            <div class="grid-3">

              ${subtypes.map((st) => `

                <button class="opt-btn ${formState.subtype === st ? "active" : ""}" data-f-subtype="${esc(st)}" type="button">${esc(st)}</button>

              `).join("")}

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="field">

            <label class="field-label" for="f-title"><span>일정 명칭 (선택)</span></label>

            <input class="input" id="f-title" type="text" maxlength="30" placeholder="${formState.kind === "outing" ? "예: 1차 정기휴가, 신병위로휴가" : "예: 편의점 알바, 저녁 약속"}" value="${esc(formState.title)}" />

          </div>

          ${formState.kind === "outing" ? `

          <div class="field">

            <div class="field-label"><span>빠른 기간 선택</span><span class="tabular" style="color:var(--accent)">${fmtDuration(formState.startDate, formState.endDate)}</span></div>

            <div class="grid-3">

              ${DURATION_PRESETS.map((p) => `

                <button class="opt-btn ${curDays === p.days ? "active" : ""}" data-f-dur="${p.days}" type="button">${p.label}</button>

              `).join("")}

            </div>

          </div>` : ""}

          <div class="grid-2" style="margin-bottom:12px;">

            <div class="field" style="margin:0;">

              <label class="field-label" for="f-start">시작일</label>

              <input class="input tabular" id="f-start" type="date" value="${esc(formState.startDate)}" />

            </div>

            <div class="field" style="margin:0;">

              <label class="field-label" for="f-end">종료일</label>

              <input class="input tabular" id="f-end" type="date" value="${esc(formState.endDate)}" />

            </div>

          </div>

          ${formState.kind === "work" ? `

          <div class="grid-2" style="margin-bottom:12px;">

            <div class="field" style="margin:0;">

              <label class="field-label" for="f-stime">시작 시간 (선택)</label>

              <input class="input tabular" id="f-stime" type="time" value="${esc(formState.startTime)}" />

            </div>

            <div class="field" style="margin:0;">

              <label class="field-label" for="f-etime">종료 시간 (선택)</label>

              <input class="input tabular" id="f-etime" type="time" value="${esc(formState.endTime)}" />

            </div>

          </div>

          ${!isEdit ? `

          <div class="field">

            <div class="field-label"><span>매주 반복 등록</span></div>

            <div class="grid-4">

              ${[1, 2, 4, 8].map((w) => `

                <button class="opt-btn ${formState.repeatWeeks === w ? "active" : ""}" data-f-repeat="${w}" type="button">${w === 1 ? "반복 없음" : `${w}주`}</button>

              `).join("")}

            </div>

          </div>` : ""}` : ""}

          <div class="field">

            <div class="field-label"><span>대표 색상</span></div>

            <div class="swatch-grid">

              ${PALETTE.map((c) => `

                <button class="swatch ${formState.color === c.hex ? "active" : ""}" style="background:${c.hex}" data-f-color="${c.hex}" title="${c.name}" type="button"></button>

              `).join("")}

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="field">

            <label class="field-label" for="f-note">메모 (선택)</label>

            <textarea class="textarea" id="f-note" placeholder="장소, 시간, 복귀 예정 등 참고 사항">${esc(formState.note)}</textarea>

          </div>

          <button class="btn-accent lg" id="f-submit" type="button">${isEdit ? "변경사항 저장" : "일정 등록하기"}</button>

        `);

        const syncInputs = () => {

          formState.author = document.getElementById("f-author").value;

          formState.title = document.getElementById("f-title").value;

          formState.startDate = document.getElementById("f-start").value || formState.startDate;

          formState.endDate = document.getElementById("f-end").value || formState.endDate;

          if (formState.endDate < formState.startDate) formState.endDate = formState.startDate;

          const stEl = document.getElementById("f-stime");

          const etEl = document.getElementById("f-etime");

          if (stEl) formState.startTime = stEl.value;

          if (etEl) formState.endTime = etEl.value;

          formState.note = document.getElementById("f-note").value;

        };

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-kind]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => {

            syncInputs();

            formState.kind = b.dataset.fKind;

            formState.subtype = formState.kind === "outing" ? "정기휴가" : "알바";

            renderForm();

          };

        });

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-status]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => { syncInputs(); formState.status = b.dataset.fStatus; renderForm(); };

        });

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-pick-name]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => { syncInputs(); formState.author = b.dataset.fPickName; renderForm(); };

        });

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-subtype]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => {

            syncInputs();

            formState.subtype = b.dataset.fSubtype;

            if (formState.subtype === "외박") formState.endDate = addDays(formState.startDate, 1);

            else if (formState.subtype === "외출") formState.endDate = formState.startDate;

            renderForm();

          };

        });

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-dur]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => {

            syncInputs();

            const d = Number(b.dataset.fDur);

            formState.endDate = addDays(formState.startDate, d - 1);

            renderForm();

          };

        });

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-repeat]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => { syncInputs(); formState.repeatWeeks = Number(b.dataset.fRepeat); renderForm(); };

        });

        document.querySelectorAll("[data-f-color]").forEach((b) => {

          b.onclick = () => { syncInputs(); formState.color = b.dataset.fColor; renderForm(); };

        });

        document.getElementById("f-start").onchange = (e) => {

          const prevLen = Math.max(0, diffDays(formState.startDate, formState.endDate));

          syncInputs();

          formState.startDate = e.target.value;

          formState.endDate = addDays(formState.startDate, prevLen);

          renderForm();

        };

        document.getElementById("f-end").onchange = (e) => {

          syncInputs();

          formState.endDate = e.target.value;

          if (formState.endDate < formState.startDate) formState.endDate = formState.startDate;

          renderForm();

        };

        document.getElementById("f-submit").onclick = async () => {

          syncInputs();

          const author = formState.author.trim();

          if (!author) { showToast("이름을 입력해 주세요"); document.getElementById("f-author").focus(); return; }

          if (!formState.startDate || !formState.endDate) { showToast("날짜를 확인해 주세요"); return; }

          rememberProfile(author, formState.color);

          const payload = {

            kind: formState.kind,

            status: formState.status,

            author,

            subtype: formState.subtype,

            title: formState.title.trim() || formState.subtype,

            startDate: formState.startDate,

            endDate: formState.endDate,

            startTime: formState.kind === "work" ? formState.startTime : "",

            endTime: formState.kind === "work" ? formState.endTime : "",

            color: formState.color,

            note: formState.note.trim()

          };

          try {

            if (isEdit) {

              const prev = state.events.find((e) => e.id === formState.id);

              await updateDoc(doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events", formState.id), {

                ...payload,

                updatedAtMs: Date.now()

              });

              const diffs = [];

              if (prev) {

                if (prev.startDate !== payload.startDate || prev.endDate !== payload.endDate) {

                  diffs.push(`날짜 ${fmtRange(prev.startDate, prev.endDate)} → ${fmtRange(payload.startDate, payload.endDate)}`);

                }

                if (prev.title !== payload.title) diffs.push(`명칭 "${prev.title}" → "${payload.title}"`);

                if (prev.status !== payload.status) diffs.push(`상태 ${prev.status === "draft" ? "가안" : "확정"} → ${payload.status === "draft" ? "가안" : "확정"}`);

              }

              await writeLog({

                action: "UPDATE",

                actor: state.profile.name || author,

                summary: `${payload.author} · ${payload.title} 일정을 수정했습니다.`,

                detail: diffs.join(" · "),

                targetDate: payload.startDate

              });

              showToast("일정이 수정되었습니다");

            } else {

              const weeks = formState.kind === "work" ? formState.repeatWeeks : 1;

              for (let w = 0; w < weeks; w++) {

                const sD = addDays(payload.startDate, w * 7);

                const eD = addDays(payload.endDate, w * 7);

                await addDoc(collection(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events"), {

                  ...payload,

                  startDate: sD,

                  endDate: eD,

                  rsvps: { ok: [], maybe: [], no: [] },

                  comments: [],

                  createdAtMs: Date.now() + w

                });

              }

              await writeLog({

                action: "CREATE",

                actor: state.profile.name || author,

                summary: `${payload.author} · ${payload.title} (${fmtRange(payload.startDate, payload.endDate)})${weeks > 1 ? ` ${weeks}주 반복` : ""} 등록`,

                detail: payload.status === "draft" ? "가안으로 등록됨" : "",

                targetDate: payload.startDate

              });

              showToast(weeks > 1 ? `${weeks}주 반복 일정이 등록되었습니다` : "일정이 등록되었습니다");

            }

            closeSheet();

          } catch (err) {

            showToast("저장 오류: " + (err.message || "권한 확인 필요"));

          }

        };

      }

      renderForm();

    }

    // 3. Event Detail Sheet (Quick Shift, Draft->Confirm, RSVP, Comments)

    function openEventDetailSheet(evId) {

      const ev = state.events.find((e) => e.id === evId);

      if (!ev) return;

      const rsvps = ev.rsvps || { ok: [], maybe: [], no: [] };

      const comments = ev.comments || [];

      const me = state.profile.name;

      openSheet(`${ev.author} · ${ev.title || ev.subtype}`, `

        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;">

          <span class="chip-dot" style="background:${esc(ev.color || "#FF6B00")};width:10px;height:10px;"></span>

          <span class="pill">${ev.kind === "outing" ? "군 출타" : "알바·개인"}</span>

          <span class="pill">${esc(ev.subtype || "")}</span>

          <span class="pill tabular">${fmtDuration(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)}</span>

          <span class="pill ${ev.status === "draft" ? "draft" : "accent"}">${ev.status === "draft" ? "가안" : "확정"}</span>

        </div>

        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:12px;">

          <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:800;" class="tabular">${fmtRange(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)}</div>

          ${ev.startTime ? `<div style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-2);margin-top:3px;" class="tabular">시간: ${esc(ev.startTime)}${ev.endTime ? " ~ " + esc(ev.endTime) : ""}</div>` : ""}

          ${ev.note ? `<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);margin-top:8px;white-space:pre-wrap;">${esc(ev.note)}</div>` : ""}

          <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">

            <button class="btn-ghost" id="det-shift-prev" type="button">-1일 이동</button>

            <button class="btn-ghost" id="det-shift-next" type="button">+1일 이동</button>

            <button class="btn-ghost" id="det-toggle-status" type="button">${ev.status === "draft" ? "확정으로 전환" : "가안으로 전환"}</button>

            <button class="btn-ghost" id="det-edit" type="button">수정</button>

            <button class="btn-ghost" id="det-del" style="color:var(--danger);" type="button">삭제</button>

          </div>

        </div>

        <div class="section-label"><span>원탭 반응 (같이 보기)</span></div>

        <div class="rsvp-row">

          ${[

            { key: "ok", label: "만남 가능" },

            { key: "maybe", label: "조율 필요" },

            { key: "no", label: "불가" }

          ].map((r) => {

            const arr = rsvps[r.key] || [];

            const active = me && arr.includes(me);

            return `

              <button class="rsvp-btn ${active ? "active" : ""}" data-rsvp="${r.key}" type="button">

                <span>${r.label} (${arr.length})</span>

                <span class="rsvp-names">${arr.length ? esc(arr.join(", ")) : "-"}</span>

              </button>

            `;

          }).join("")}

        </div>

        <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:14px;"><span>댓글 (${comments.length})</span></div>

        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:10px;">

          ${comments.length === 0 ? `<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);text-align:center;padding:8px 0;">첫 댓글을 남겨 약속을 조율해 보세요.</div>` : comments.map((c) => `

            <div class="comment-item">

              <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:2px;">

                <strong style="font-size:12.5px;">${esc(c.author)}</strong>

                <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);" class="tabular">${fmtRelative(c.createdAtMs)}</span>

              </div>

              <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text);word-break:break-word;">${esc(c.text)}</div>

            </div>

          `).join("")}

        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">

          <input class="input" id="det-comment-input" type="text" placeholder="${me ? me + "(으)로 댓글 남기기" : "댓글 입력 (이름 미설정 시 입력 요청)"}" />

          <button class="btn-accent" style="height:auto;flex-shrink:0;" id="det-comment-send" type="button">등록</button>

        </div>

      `);

      const ensureName = () => {

        if (state.profile.name) return state.profile.name;

        const n = window.prompt("사용할 본인 이름을 입력해 주세요 (이후 자동 저장됩니다):");

        if (!n || !n.trim()) return null;

        rememberProfile(n.trim(), state.profile.color);

        return n.trim();

      };

      const shiftEvent = async (delta) => {

        const ns = addDays(ev.startDate, delta);

        const ne = addDays(ev.endDate, delta);

        await updateDoc(doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events", ev.id), { startDate: ns, endDate: ne, updatedAtMs: Date.now() });

        await writeLog({

          action: "UPDATE",

          actor: state.profile.name || ev.author,

          summary: `${ev.author} · ${ev.title} 일정을 ${delta > 0 ? "+1일" : "-1일"} 이동`,

          detail: `${fmtRange(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)} → ${fmtRange(ns, ne)}`,

          targetDate: ns

        });

        showToast("날짜를 이동했습니다");

        setTimeout(() => openEventDetailSheet(ev.id), 180);

      };

      document.getElementById("det-shift-prev").onclick = () => shiftEvent(-1);

      document.getElementById("det-shift-next").onclick = () => shiftEvent(1);

      document.getElementById("det-toggle-status").onclick = async () => {

        const nextStatus = ev.status === "draft" ? "confirmed" : "draft";

        await updateDoc(doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events", ev.id), { status: nextStatus, updatedAtMs: Date.now() });

        await writeLog({

          action: "UPDATE",

          actor: state.profile.name || ev.author,

          summary: `${ev.author} · ${ev.title} 상태를 ${nextStatus === "confirmed" ? "확정" : "가안"}으로 변경`,

          targetDate: ev.startDate

        });

        showToast(nextStatus === "confirmed" ? "확정 일정으로 전환되었습니다" : "가안으로 전환되었습니다");

        setTimeout(() => openEventDetailSheet(ev.id), 180);

      };

      document.getElementById("det-edit").onclick = () => openEventFormSheet(ev);

      document.getElementById("det-del").onclick = async () => {

        if (!window.confirm(`"${ev.author} · ${ev.title}" 일정을 삭제할까요?`)) return;

        await deleteDoc(doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events", ev.id));

        await writeLog({

          action: "DELETE",

          actor: state.profile.name || ev.author,

          summary: `${ev.author} · ${ev.title} (${fmtRange(ev.startDate, ev.endDate)}) 일정을 삭제했습니다.`,

          targetDate: ev.startDate

        });

        closeSheet();

        showToast("일정이 삭제되었습니다");

      };

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-rsvp]").forEach((btn) => {

        btn.onclick = async () => {

          const actor = ensureName();

          if (!actor) return;

          const key = btn.dataset.rsvp;

          const next = {

            ok: [...(rsvps.ok || [])].filter((x) => x !== actor),

            maybe: [...(rsvps.maybe || [])].filter((x) => x !== actor),

            no: [...(rsvps.no || [])].filter((x) => x !== actor)

          };

          const wasInKey = (rsvps[key] || []).includes(actor);

          if (!wasInKey) next[key].push(actor);

          await updateDoc(doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events", ev.id), { rsvps: next });

          if (!wasInKey) {

            const labelMap = { ok: "만남 가능", maybe: "조율 필요", no: "불가" };

            await writeLog({

              action: "RSVP",

              actor,

              summary: `${ev.author} · ${ev.title} 일정에 [${labelMap[key]}] 표시`,

              targetDate: ev.startDate

            });

          }

          setTimeout(() => openEventDetailSheet(ev.id), 180);

        };

      });

      const sendComment = async () => {

        const input = document.getElementById("det-comment-input");

        const text = input.value.trim();

        if (!text) return;

        const actor = ensureName();

        if (!actor) return;

        const nextComments = [...comments, { id: String(Date.now()), author: actor, text, createdAtMs: Date.now() }];

        await updateDoc(doc(db, "rooms", state.roomId, "events", ev.id), { comments: nextComments });

        await writeLog({

          action: "COMMENT",

          actor,

          summary: `${ev.author} · ${ev.title}에 댓글: "${text.slice(0, 40)}"`,

          targetDate: ev.startDate

        });

        input.value = "";

        setTimeout(() => openEventDetailSheet(ev.id), 180);

      };

      document.getElementById("det-comment-send").onclick = sendComment;

      document.getElementById("det-comment-input").onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") sendComment(); };

    }

    // =========================================================================

    // Actions & Utilities

    // =========================================================================

    function shiftMonth(delta) {

      const d = new Date(state.calYear, state.calMonth + delta, 1);

      state.calYear = d.getFullYear();

      state.calMonth = d.getMonth();

      render();

    }

    async function copyText(str, msg) {

      try {

        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(str);

        showToast(msg);

      } catch {

        const ta = document.createElement("textarea");

        ta.value = str;

        document.body.appendChild(ta);

        ta.select();

        document.execCommand("copy");

        document.body.removeChild(ta);

        showToast(msg);

      }

    }

    function buildMonthSummaryText() {

      const mStr = `${state.calYear}-${pad2(state.calMonth + 1)}`;

      const evs = getFilteredEvents().filter((e) => e.startDate.slice(0, 7) <= mStr && e.endDate.slice(0, 7) >= mStr);

      const lines = [`[chulta4] ${state.calYear}년 ${state.calMonth + 1}월 공유 일정`];

      if (evs.length === 0) {

        lines.push("• 등록된 일정 없음");

      } else {

        evs.forEach((e) => {

          const tag = e.status === "draft" ? "(가안) " : "";

          lines.push(`• ${fmtRange(e.startDate, e.endDate)} | ${e.author} — ${tag}${e.title || e.subtype} (${fmtDuration(e.startDate, e.endDate)})`);

        });

      }

      lines.push("", `실시간 달력: ${window.location.href}`);

      return lines.join("\n");

    }

    // Global Event Delegation

    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {

      const tabBtn = e.target.closest(".nav-tab[data-tab]");

      if (tabBtn) {

        state.tab = tabBtn.dataset.tab;

        render();

        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "instant" });

        return;

      }

      if (e.target.closest("#mini-ticker")) {

        state.tab = "dday";

        render();

        return;

      }

      const evEl = e.target.closest("[data-ev-id]");

      if (evEl) {

        e.stopPropagation();

        openEventDetailSheet(evEl.dataset.evId);

        return;

      }

      const dayCell = e.target.closest(".day-bg-cell[data-day]");

      if (dayCell) {

        if (longPressFired) { longPressFired = false; return; }

        openDaySheet(dayCell.dataset.day);

        return;

      }

      const actEl = e.target.closest("[data-action]");

      if (!actEl) return;

      const act = actEl.dataset.action;

      if (act === "prev-month") shiftMonth(-1);

      else if (act === "next-month") shiftMonth(1);

      else if (act === "go-today") {

        const t = new Date();

        state.calYear = t.getFullYear();

        state.calMonth = t.getMonth();

        state.scrollOffsetStart = 0;

        state.selectedDay = todayYMD();

        render();

      } else if (act === "set-view") {

        state.viewMode = actEl.dataset.val;

        saveLS("chulta4_view_mode", state.viewMode);

        render();

      } else if (act === "scroll-prev-more") {

        state.scrollOffsetStart -= 1;

        state.scrollMonthsCount += 1;

        render();

      } else if (act === "scroll-next-more") {

        state.scrollMonthsCount += 2;

        render();

      } else if (act === "kind-filter") {

        state.kindFilter = actEl.dataset.val;

        render();

      } else if (act === "toggle-doodles") {

        state.showDoodles = !state.showDoodles;

        render();

      } else if (act === "toggle-person") {

        const p = actEl.dataset.person;

        if (state.hiddenPeople.has(p)) state.hiddenPeople.delete(p);

        else state.hiddenPeople.add(p);

        render();

      } else if (act === "people-all") {

        state.hiddenPeople.clear();

        render();

      } else if (act === "people-none") {

        getPeopleList().forEach((p) => state.hiddenPeople.add(p.name));

        render();

      } else if (act === "people-mine") {

        state.hiddenPeople.clear();

        getPeopleList().forEach((p) => { if (p.name !== state.profile.name) state.hiddenPeople.add(p.name); });

        render();

      } else if (act === "dday-all") {

        state.ddayHiddenPeople.clear();

        render();

      } else if (act === "dday-mine") {

        state.ddayHiddenPeople.clear();

        getPeopleList().forEach((p) => { if (p.name !== state.profile.name) state.ddayHiddenPeople.add(p.name); });

        render();

      } else if (act === "dday-toggle-person") {

        const p = actEl.dataset.person;

        if (state.ddayHiddenPeople.has(p)) state.ddayHiddenPeople.delete(p);

        else state.ddayHiddenPeople.add(p);

        render();

      } else if (act === "toggle-past") {

        state.showPastOutings = !state.showPastOutings;

        render();

      } else if (act === "open-add-outing") {

        openEventFormSheet({ kind: "outing" });

      } else if (act === "rec-days") {

        state.recDays = Number(actEl.dataset.val);

        render();

      } else if (act === "rec-strategy") {

        state.recStrategy = actEl.dataset.val;

        render();

      } else if (act === "rec-horizon") {

        state.recHorizon = Number(actEl.dataset.val);

        render();

      } else if (act === "rec-toggle-target") {

        const p = actEl.dataset.person;

        if (state.recTargets.has(p)) state.recTargets.delete(p);

        else state.recTargets.add(p);

        render();

      } else if (act === "rec-apply") {

        openEventFormSheet({

          kind: "outing",

          startDate: actEl.dataset.start,

          endDate: actEl.dataset.end,

          status: actEl.dataset.status

        });

      } else if (act === "activity-sub") {

        state.activitySub = actEl.dataset.val;

        render();

      } else if (act === "jump-date") {

        const ymd = actEl.dataset.date;

        const d = parseYMD(ymd);

        state.calYear = d.getFullYear();

        state.calMonth = d.getMonth();

        state.selectedDay = ymd;

        state.tab = "calendar";

        render();

      } else if (act === "set-profile-color") {

        state.profile.color = actEl.dataset.hex;

        saveLS("chulta4_profile", state.profile);

        render();

      } else if (act === "save-profile") {

        const name = document.getElementById("set-name").value.trim();

        state.profile.name = name;

        rememberProfile(name, state.profile.color);

        saveLS("chulta4_profile", state.profile);

        showToast("내 프리셋이 저장되었습니다");

        render();

      } else if (act === "set-theme") {

        state.theme = actEl.dataset.val;

        saveLS("chulta4_theme", state.theme);

        render();

      } else if (act === "set-accent") {

        state.accent = actEl.dataset.val;

        saveLS("chulta4_accent", state.accent);

        render();

      } else if (act === "copy-link") {

        copyText(window.location.href, "공유 링크가 복사되었습니다");

      } else if (act === "copy-month-text") {

        copyText(buildMonthSummaryText(), "월간 일정 요약이 복사되었습니다");

      } else if (act === "switch-room") {

        const val = document.getElementById("room-input").value.trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "");

        if (!val) { showToast("영문 또는 숫자 룸 코드를 입력해 주세요"); return; }

        connectRoom(val);

        showToast(`#${val} 룸으로 이동했습니다`);

      } else if (act === "random-room") {

        const code = "r" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

        connectRoom(code);

        showToast(`새 공유 룸 #${code} 생성됨`);

      } else if (act === "export-json") {

        const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify({ roomId: state.roomId, exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), events: state.events, logs: state.logs }, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });

        const a = document.createElement("a");

        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        a.download = `chulta4-${state.roomId}-${todayYMD()}.json`;

        a.click();

        showToast("백업 파일을 다운로드했습니다");

      }

    });

    // Header & Modal Buttons

    document.getElementById("btn-share").onclick = () => copyText(window.location.href, "공유 링크가 복사되었습니다");

    document.getElementById("btn-theme-toggle").onclick = () => {

      state.theme = state.theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";

      saveLS("chulta4_theme", state.theme);

      render();

    };

    document.getElementById("fab-add").onclick = () => openEventFormSheet({ startDate: state.selectedDay, endDate: state.selectedDay });

    document.getElementById("sheet-close").onclick = closeSheet;

    document.getElementById("sheet-backdrop").onclick = (e) => {

      if (e.target.id === "sheet-backdrop") closeSheet();

    };

    // Init

    applyTheme();

    render();

    connectRoom(state.roomId);

  </script>

</body>

</html>
